summary: Phase 2 (Office Admin Dashboard + Quick Entry hub + Incentive eligibility) verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (test_iteration13.py). Frontend: All 14 acceptance flows pass on https://admin-portal-558.preview.emergentagent.com — OfficeDashboard renders for office_admin with stat-admissions/stat-incentive-earned/stat-incentive-pending/stat-staff-count, week/month/year window toggles trigger reload, Ravi Kumar staff row expands and shows 3 May-2026 admissions all eligible at ₹500 (totals: 3 admissions, ₹1500 earned, ₹500 pending after one paid in seed). Mark-paid → row flips to 'Paid' badge with data-testid=unmark-<sid>; Unmark restores 'Mark paid · ₹500' button. QuickEntry hub shows 4 cards (qe-add-transaction amber, qe-request-expense rose, qe-add-student emerald, qe-log-payment violet); qe-add-transaction swaps to keypad form with working data-testid=qe-back-to-hub. qe-request-expense → /expense-requests?new=1 auto-opens [data-testid=new-request-dialog]. qe-add-student → /students?new=1 auto-opens Add dialog. qe-log-payment → /students?action=log_payment shows [data-testid=log-payment-banner]. Super admin (admin@finflow.com) → SuperAdminDashboard ([data-testid=dashboard-page]) renders; OfficeDashboard NOT present. No React errors / rules-of-hooks overlay — SuperAdminDashboard was correctly extracted.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py office_admin_dashboard cleanly two-passes the students collection: first to build monthly counts for eligibility, then to build per-staff rows. O(n) and correct. The retroactive eligibility rule (3+ admissions in a calendar month → ALL admissions in that (staff, month) become eligible) works as specified.
_student_admission_dt handles both 'YYYY-MM-DD' enrollment_date and ISO created_at with TZ — defensive try/except fallback prevents crashes on bad data.
_days_until_birthday correctly rolls to next year when this year's birthday has passed; returns 999 as sentinel for malformed DOB which is filtered out by the <=30 check.
Free-text reference mismatch is handled silently (continue when staff_by_name lookup misses) — verified in test_legacy_reference_does_not_crash. No error surfaces to user.
students.py mark-paid / unmark-paid are clean idempotent endpoints with proper 404 handling and use $set / $unset correctly.

OfficeDashboard.jsx uses React hooks in correct order (useAuth, useState x3, useEffect); Dashboard.jsx wraps SuperAdminDashboard as a sibling component so the early-return on role does not violate rules-of-hooks. Verified — no React error overlay during navigation.

QuickEntry.jsx HubCard helper is well-scoped; the hub/transaction view toggle via local state is clean. qe-back-to-hub button is only rendered in the transaction view (per agent-to-agent context — intentional).

Minor: dashboard.py uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) but compares against enrollment_date that was parsed as naive midnight UTC — works fine but mixing aware/naive is fragile. Already wrapped in try/except.
Minor: OfficeDashboard.jsx 'window' is a state variable name that shadows the browser global window — harmless inside component scope but stylistic.

Minor: incentive_paid totals on each row only credit a paid admission's amount if that month is eligible (correct). Already-paid admissions whose month later drops below 3 will silently stop being counted toward incentive_paid — expected behaviour but worth documenting.
